ResourceList.Name: Minecraft_Diverge_Beta_Rework_Resources
ResourceList.Attribution:
The majority of the assets in Minecraft Diverge's resource repository has been made by other people. The audio here is (hopefully) under fair use. I am not a lawyer and I do not know how this stuff works: I am just some random guy on the internet making a mod for fun.
